people.imagined: Dusk at the graves, the chorus seated in rows. He has just heard a cough and tilts his head to find it, deciding who will be struck from the roll. The old scar on his throat catches the last light.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk among grave mounds, he tilts his head sharply to the left, listening for a cough in the chorus, and is about to decide something. Face, most important: a pale raised cord of scar runs all the way around his throat like a thin necklace, plainly visible above the collar. A long, calm, bony face of forty; skin the colour of tallow; narrow dark eyes with the lids half lowered; thin straight eyebrows; a long nose; a mouth set in a small patient line. Hair: black with a few grey threads, combed straight back and tied in a low knot with a white hemp cord. Body: tall and narrow, straight-backed, chin lifted to listen. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe of good clean cloth with a crossed collar, a thin ash-grey sash, wide sleeves; a black band at the cuff. Hands: one hand raised to cup behind his left ear. Qi: a faint green-teal damp haze at the shoulder. Background: blurred rows of seated singers in white hemp and low earth mounds. Light: low amber dusk from the upper left, cool grey shadow on the right. The scar is a pale ridge as wide as a finger, puckered where it crosses the windpipe, and his collar is cut low enough to show it; his shoulders are held rigidly square and the long fingers of his raised hand are fanned, nails clean and pale, with the lowering light running along his cheekbone. Expression: devout, calm, with a touch of arbitrary coldness in the set of the mouth.

people.imagined: She kneels at a river grave with a stick of chalk, finishing a seal line, and looks up as though she has heard someone count coins. The silver ring swings on its string.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a river grave, she looks up mid-line from a seal she is chalking, shrewd and a little amused, as if she has heard someone counting money. Face, most important: her palms and fingers are ground white with chalk dust, deep in every line, held up in front of her, and a single silver ring hangs on a string at her neck, catching the light. A heart-shaped face, thirty; clear tan skin; sharp, quick brown eyes under neat arched brows; a small straight nose; full lips with one corner lifted. Hair: black, in a tidy double bun low at the nape, held by two bone pins, with a few loose strands. Body: slim, compact, leaning forward on one knee. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe, clean and well cut, sleeves tied back with white cord above the elbow so the forearms are bare; an ash-grey sash; a brown cloth apron with chalk smears. Hands and objects: a stub of white chalk pinched between thumb and finger. Background: blurred green riverbank and a mossy grave stone. Light: soft silvery daylight from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale metallic gleam in the chalk dust. The silver ring on its string is a plain narrow band that swings against the grey-white hemp when she leans; chalk dust has settled in a fine film on her lashes and on the hem of her apron, and her bare forearms are tanned and lightly freckled, with a small old nick across one knuckle. Expression: a shrewd, slightly amused look with a raised brow and one corner of the mouth lifted, eyes quick.

people.imagined: A ridge hunter's boy stands at a cave mouth with a sack of millet at his feet, selling a widow a dead man's name. In the dim light his eyes have gone white. He is making the name up and hopes his face does not show it.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the mouth of a dark cave in lamplight, he has just told a lie to the viewer and is holding still so his face will not betray it. Face, most important: his eyes are milk-white, pale and clouded, with only the pupil dots showing, plainly strange. A thin sixteen-year-old face; sun-brown skin with a few spots of acne on the cheek; a broad flat nose; chapped lips pressed together; thick uneven eyebrows. Around his neck hangs a necklace of animal teeth with several gaps where teeth are missing. Hair: coarse black, cut short with a hunting knife, standing in tufts. Body: wiry, hunched slightly, shoulders raised. Clothing: a hunter's coat of brown fur-trimmed wool, clean and newly mended, over a plain undyed hemp shirt; a leather cord at the collar. Hands: one hand holds up a single tooth of the necklace between finger and thumb. Background: the black mouth of a cave with a single guttering lantern. Light: weak yellow lamplight from lower left, cold blue shadow. Qi: a faint violet-black shimmer at the edge of his shoulders. The tooth necklace is made of about a dozen yellowed canine teeth on a greasy leather thong, with three bare knots where teeth were sold; his knuckles are chapped raw, the nails bitten short, and the thin cave-wind lifts the fur at his collar while the lamp makes his white eyes shine like wet pearls. Expression: a half-smile held a moment too long with wide, still eyes and a stiff face working not to betray itself.

people.imagined: Dawn on the pavilion's stone steps. She is sweeping, singing off-key on purpose, loudly, so that the dead will know her voice.
people.subject: The moment: sweeping stone steps at dawn, she throws back her head and sings loudly, deliberately off-key, with her mouth open and eyes shut. Face, most important: a thin white fishhook scar cuts through her left eyebrow, splitting it in two, easy to see. A round, freckled, sunburnt sixteen-year-old face, broad cheeks, wide mouth with a gap between the front teeth, small dark eyes crinkled with a grin. Hair: wavy brown, tied up in a messy knot with a bit of fishing twine, wisps stuck to a damp neck. Body: sturdy and square, big hands. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning smock of clean plain cloth, cut short in the sleeve, white hemp cord at the waist. Hands: a straw broom held upright against her shoulder. Background: pale stone steps, a few grave mounds, mist on a distant river. Light: pink-gold dawn from the upper left. Qi: a faint teal damp glimmer on her hair. Her feet and ankles are bare and grey-wet on the stone, with a pale line where a net-cord once chafed; the broom's twigs are bound with red thread, the steps fall away behind her in pale steps, and a few pearl-grey river gulls turn over the water in the soft dawn. Expression: an open mouth in loud song, eyes shut and chin lifted, a stubborn, joyful face.

people.imagined: Late in the day in the copy room, draught in the shutters. His hair has come undone again. He stands at the door to hold someone talking, smiling too evenly.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a copy-room door in the afternoon draught, he is making conversation to hold someone back, one hand lifted, smiling too evenly. Face, most important: a thin wooden ruling-stick is tucked behind his right ear, standing out plainly beside his head, and his hair, neat in the morning, has come half undone and stands in wisps. A narrow, careful, pleasant face of twenty-four; fair skin with ink on the cheek; light brown eyes; thin neat brows; a small straight nose; a smile that does not reach the eyes. Hair: dark brown, a centre parting, falling loose over the ears. Body: slight, slightly stooped from desk work. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe of clean fine cloth with a close collar and narrow sleeves, ash-grey sash, the padded edge of a quilted winter lining showing at the collar. Hands: an inked brush in one hand held like a pointer. Background: blurred shelves of bound books with plain covers, a paper window. Light: cool draughty grey light from the left. Qi: faint pale green at the shoulder. His fingernails are neatly pared and inky at the edges, the hair that has escaped the parting hangs in two pale-brown wings over his ears, and the ruling-stick is a slim reddish bamboo about a hand long, sharpened at the tip; a draught lifts a loose sheet of paper behind him. Expression: a smile held too evenly with tense eyes and a faintly strained brow, the cheeks stiff.

people.imagined: In the bamboo grove she sits on a cut cane, restless, drumming her fingers on a flute she cannot play through. She has just won an argument that the grove counts as the Pavilion.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a cut bamboo cane in the grove, drumming her fingers on a flute she cannot play through, bored and pleased with herself after winning an argument that the grove counts as the Pavilion. Face: most important, a thin pale scar from a bamboo splinter runs down the centre of her lower lip, silvery and clearly visible, and her fingers blur mid-drum on the flute. It is a narrow, pointed face of seventeen, light brown, with large restless dark eyes that glance sideways, thin brows, a small upturned nose and a quick sly smile. Hair: black, in two short high pigtails tied with undyed hemp, one slightly uneven. Body: wiry, perched forward with one knee up, bare ankles scratched, a few curled shavings round her sandals. Clothing: a clean, well-made undyed hemp mourning robe with the sleeves pushed up to the elbows and an ash-grey sash tied carelessly. Hands and objects: a dark bamboo flute with a row of six finger-holes held in both hands, fingers lifted and tapping; a faint green tint around the fingers. Background: tall blurred bamboo stalks with scars from old lightning. Light: green-filtered daylight from the upper left, a long shaft of sun falling through the stalks onto the flute. Expression: impatient and lazy, cheeky, the sly smile of someone who has just won and is already bored.

people.imagined: He sweeps his forebears' graves in a hamlet on ruined stone. A third broom has just snapped in his hands and he holds the two pieces, calm and a little embarrassed.
people.subject: The moment: standing among old graves with a broken broom, he looks down at the two halves in his hands, steady and quietly puzzled, a little embarrassed that a third broom has snapped. Face: most important, his left sleeve is grey to the elbow with grave dust, in sharp contrast with the clean white right sleeve, and the snapped broom shaft is in his fist. It is a broad, weathered, open face of twenty-two, tanned, with high cheekbones, thick straight eyebrows, deep-set steady grey eyes and a heavy jaw with a day's stubble. Hair: thick black, cropped short, a few strands dusted grey. Body: a thick-shouldered farmer's build, a little stooped and very still. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe of clean, sturdy cloth with a plain hemp collar and rope belt, the right sleeve bleached nearly white by washing and the left taken to the colour of ash, a few blades of dry grass clinging to the cuff. Hands and objects: both hands hold the two pieces of a bundled-twig broom, dry pale bristles fanned out; a faint damp-green haze low at the elbow. Background: low earth graves, a broken old stone wall, thin grass. Light: flat pale autumn light from the upper left, the sky wide as milk behind him. Expression: a calm, a little embarrassed face with lowered eyes on the broken pieces and a soft rueful mouth.

people.imagined: Night at the graves. The bell on her wrist is ringing though she has not moved. She looks toward a door that was barred behind her sixty years ago, and smiles very slightly.
people.subject: The moment: standing still at night among the graves, she looks toward a door that was barred behind her sixty years ago, smiling very slightly, while a small bronze bell at her wrist rings on its own. Face: most important, a gaunt, hollow-cheeked face with deep eye sockets and skin like old paper, almost grey-white, with a small bronze bell on a cord around her wrist raised near her cheek. She is about forty-five, with dark, level, unblinking eyes, thin straight severe brows, a long thin nose and narrow pale lips set in a slight flat smile. Hair: black streaked with long strands of white, hanging straight to the shoulders, parted in the middle, with no ornament but a plain white hemp cord. Body: tall, narrow-shouldered and very upright. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe of the finest cloth with a high closed collar and a heavy wide sleeve, edged at hem and cuff with a black band, grave earth ground into the hem. Hands and objects: the wrist raised, the bell no bigger than a walnut, green at the seams, hung from a cord of braided white hair; the fingers long and bloodless, the nails trimmed square. Background: black night with low mounds and one faint lantern, a cold violet-black mist. Light: cold lantern light from the lower left, pale grey on the face. Expression: a faint, cold smile with an absolutely still face and fixed, unwarm eyes.

people.imagined: Evening at the graves, at the start of the chant. He opens his mouth and the valley fills, though he does not raise his voice. The zither on his back hums a little by itself.
people.subject: The moment: at the start of the evening chant, he stands with his mouth just opening, face lifted, as a quiet voice swells to fill the valley. Face, most important: a long dark zither strapped diagonally across his back, its end rising behind his shoulder, and a wide, soft-spoken old man's face, clean-shaven. Age about sixty-five; weathered brown skin with deep lines from nose to mouth; kind, deep-set hooded eyes with heavy lids; white bushy eyebrows; a broad nose; a gentle wide mouth. Hair: thin white, tied in a small knot, a few loose strands. Body: stocky and broad-chested, round shoulders. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe of clean fine cloth, a slightly yellowed white, with an ash-grey sash and a black band at the cuff; the zither's red-brown cord crosses the chest. Hands: one hand open at his chest, fingers curved as a drummer's would be. Background: a blurred valley of graves at evening. Light: orange evening light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-teal ripple like water in the air near his mouth. The zither is long as a man's arm with nine silk strings pale as hairs and a dark lacquered body worn bare where his shoulder carries it; his big hands are calloused at the fingertips, his throat shows a visible swell as he draws breath, and the evening light edges his white hair in gold. Expression: a calm, lifted face with the mouth just opening, deep sad eyes and a quiet reserve behind them.

people.imagined: At the jade beds, dirt to the elbow. She lifts the jade-cutter's lens to look at a green fleck in a stone, three in a hundred years, and thinks the head too patient.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a jade bed, she lifts a cutter's lens to her eye and squints at a small green fleck in grey stone, then looks up with a hard impatient stare. Face, most important: a brass-rimmed jade-cutter's lens on a cord held up in one hand, and her forearms black with dirt to the elbow. A square-jawed, plain face of about forty; swarthy skin; heavy straight brows; small dark eyes; a wide flat nose; thick lips pressed in a line. Hair: black, plaited into one thick braid wound around the head. Body: broad, square-shouldered, strong. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe, clean at the chest and well cut, sleeves rolled to the elbow; an ash-grey sash; a leather apron. Hands: a small green-flecked stone in one palm, the lens in the other. Background: dark earth beds and pale stones in neat rows. Light: sharp flat daylight from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-teal sparkle at the stone. The lens is a thick disc of rock crystal in a worn brass ring, the cord around her neck is greasy with use, and her fingernails are rimmed with black earth; she kneels on a flat square of sacking, with rows of low jade beds behind her marked by small unlettered stakes. Expression: a hard, resentful stare over the lens with a tight mouth and narrowed eyes.

people.imagined: A copyist at his desk in the draught, left hand writing, right hand cupped over his ear as though to shield it from a wind. The oldest song is still unfinished.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk in lamplight, he writes with his left hand while his right is cupped over his ear, shielding it from a wind that is not there, and squints at the viewer without seeing them clearly. Face, most important: the right hand cupped behind the right ear, and eyes screwed up in a short-sighted squint. A thin, short, sallow face of thirty-five; light brown skin; narrow eyes under drooping lids; thin brows raised; a sharp nose; a mouth slightly open as if listening. Hair: dark, thin, parted and combed flat, with an inky smudge on the forehead. Body: small, thin, shoulders drawn forward. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe with a thick quilted winter lining showing as a padded edge at the neck; ash-grey sash; ink on the left cuff. Hands and objects: the left hand holds a brush above a blank sheet of pale paper; a small drum of dark wood stands at the edge of the desk. Background: blurred shelves and a single lamp. Light: warm lamp light from the lower left, cool dark behind. Qi: a faint blue-teal ripple near his ear. The brushes in the box at his elbow are a dozen, bound in a rolled cloth, each handle worn dark at the grip; a bead of wax runs down the lamp, his ear is reddened from pressing, and the quilted lining at his collar is stitched with fine neat rows in grey thread. Expression: an absorbed, squinting face with brows drawn in concentration and lips slightly parted as he listens.

people.imagined: At the graves in autumn, she sings to a boy who drowned. She has laughed her hoarse brook-water laugh at a memory, and two white hairs have come loose.
people.subject: The moment: standing among graves in autumn, she laughs hoarsely at a private memory, head turned a little to one side. Face, most important: two white hairs stand out against her dark hair at the left temple, left unplucked and catching the light, and her laugh shows her open mouth. A warm, broad face of thirty-two with laugh-lines; brown skin; dark bright eyes; thick straight brows; a rounded nose; a wide smile. Hair: black, in a loose low braid over her shoulder with two white strands visible. Body: sturdy, relaxed, hand-on-hip stance. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe of good clean cloth with a crossed collar, wide sleeves, an ash-grey sash, a small blue ribbon tied at one wrist. Hands: holding two small cups of water, one in each palm, side by side. Background: blurred autumn grass and low mounds, two small streams glinting. Light: warm gold autumn sun from the upper left. Qi: a faint teal shimmer on the water. The two cups are plain brown clay and the water in them trembles with each laugh, one cup bright and clear, the other faintly clouded; the small blue ribbon at her wrist is faded to the colour of a washed sky, and warm light finds the creases beside her eyes. Expression: a hoarse laugh fading into a soft, sad smile, eyes warm and slightly wet, the head turned aside.

people.imagined: He stands in the cave hall in ridge furs, an unlit lamp at his belt. He is choosing which hunters' child to shut in tonight, and looks at the viewer as at a possible child.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a cave hall, he studies the viewer from under heavy brows as though choosing which hunters' child to shut in tonight. Face: most important, a short, heavy man in ridge furs, with a round unlit cave lamp of dark iron held in one fist at his chest on a greasy cord wrapped twice round it. He is about fifty-five, with tanned leathery skin, thick grey-black eyebrows with a scar through one, small deep-set black eyes, a thick nose with a broken bridge, heavy jowls and a closed unsmiling mouth. Hair: grey-black, cropped short, with an iron-grey beard trimmed square. Body: short, thick and powerful. Clothing: a heavy brown fur-collared hunter's coat of clean thick cloth, held by a bone toggle, over an undyed hemp mourning robe with a white cord at the waist, fur at the shoulders smelling of smoke. Hands and objects: gripping the lamp, black iron and round as a melon with a dry white wick; a faint grey metal gleam on it. Background: black cave stone behind him, a few bones set in niches, violet-black at the edges. Light: dim reddish brazier light from the lower left, showing the scar through the eyebrow. Expression: stubborn and loyal, flat and cruel, the heavy stare of a man looking at a possible child.

people.imagined: He sways to a planting beat only he can hear. The graves answered his own song back to him, and his village has not forgiven him. He grins anyway, thinking of the next verse.
people.subject: The moment: swaying on his feet to an invisible planting beat, he grins sideways at the viewer as if about to launch into a song, thinking of the next verse. Face: most important, a deeply sunburnt neck and throat, red-brown above a clean white collar, and his head mid-sway, tilted. It is a long, cheerful, loose-featured face of twenty-two, red-brown and peeling slightly on the nose, with bright hazel eyes, mobile thick brows, a wide uneven grin and a dimple in the chin. Hair: short brown, sun-streaked, sticking up. Body: tall and loose-limbed, one shoulder dropped. Clothing: a clean undyed hemp mourning robe of fresh cloth with a loose collar, the sleeves rolled to the elbow with ends dark from paddy mud, an ash-grey sash, and a wide yellow rice-straw hat pushed back, its chin cord loose on his chest, its edge worn by the sun. Hands and objects: one hand slapping the beat on his thigh, the other held up with fingers spread, the forearms brown and wiry; a faint green glow on the straw hat. Background: blurred green rice shoots at the edge of the graves. Light: bright sun from the upper left, with hard highlights on the cheekbones and teeth. Expression: cheerful and gregarious, easily distracted, a loose delighted grin from a man whose village has not forgiven his song.

people.imagined: She taps a drum rhythm on her knee without knowing it. She has just been handed the copy room's key and tries not to look at the clerk who lost it.
people.subject: The moment: sitting forward with her hand tapping her knee in a slow rhythm, she holds an iron key on a cord up in the other hand and does not look at the man standing beside her. Face, most important: a crooked fringe cut with her own knife, short on one side and long on the other, over a sharp, narrow face of twenty-three. Pale skin with a few freckles; narrow dark eyes slanted a little upward; thin straight eyebrows; a sharp chin; thin lips pressed in a hidden smile. Hair: black, a straight blunt bob with the uneven fringe. Body: thin, sharp-shouldered. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe of good clean cloth with a high close collar, narrow sleeves with ash-grey cuffs, grey sash; a small drum-skin patch sewn at the left shoulder. Hands: right hand on her knee, fingers tapping; left hand holds an old iron key on a cord. Background: blurred shelves of bound books. Light: cool grey light from the left, a lamp glow behind. Qi: a faint pale-blue shimmer on her fingers. The key is a long old iron one with a ring bow, tied on a faded red cord, and her thumbnail is bitten; the little drum-skin patch at her shoulder is a round of pale hide stitched with black thread, and her sharp collarbones show above the closed collar in the cold grey light. Expression: a restless, secretly pleased face with a pressed-down smile and eyes carefully turned away from the clerk.

people.imagined: A fisher girl on the pavilion's hill, wide-eyed and careful, remembering the net that came up with a singing skull in it. She wrings her rough hands.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a hillside in wind, a fisher girl wrings her rough hands and looks wide-eyed at the viewer, trying to be polite after being sent up the hill, remembering the net that came up with a singing skull in it. Face: most important, one dark curl hangs down over her cheek, wet and shining though everything else about her is dry, and her hands are red and cracked from nets. It is a small, round, earnest face of fifteen, tanned olive, with big dark eyes under wet lashes, thin neat eyebrows, a small snub nose and a shy half-smile. Hair: black, tied in a plain tail with hemp string, one curl loose and wet, lifted by the wind so that it clings to the cheek. Body: small and round-shouldered, the wrists thin. Clothing: a clean, new, still stiff undyed hemp mourning smock with a white cord belt and sleeves a little too long, hanging over the knuckles; a netting cord looped around one wrist. Hands and objects: clasped together at the chest, the palms red and cracked with white lines where the net-cords have cut; a faint blue-teal sheen on the wet curl. Background: a pale grey sky, a hill, and a thread of river far below, silver in the grey. Light: damp grey light from the upper left. Expression: cautious and humble, patient, the polite, anxious attention of a girl who does not yet know what she is wanted for.

people.imagined: He comes out of the grove with a bundle of lightning-struck canes, lopsided from the weight, a flute half bored in his hand. He wants only to be left alone.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a bamboo grove with a bundle of dark canes over one shoulder, leaning to one side under the weight, he looks at the viewer with calm reserve; he wants only to be left alone. Face: most important, a lopsided posture, one shoulder high and the other low, and rows of small pale crescent bore-nicks across both thumbs. It is a long, patient, quiet face of twenty-eight, olive, with heavy-lidded brown eyes, straight eyebrows, a long straight nose and a closed mouth. Hair: black, tied in a topknot with a green cord. Body: lanky, one shoulder pulled up by habit, a leather pad on the shoulder under the canes. Clothing: a clean undyed hemp mourning robe of sturdy cloth with narrow sleeves and a close collar, a grey sash, and sandals laced with green bamboo bark. Hands and objects: four canes as thick as a wrist, scorched black in zigzag lines where lightning struck them and tied with straw rope, on his shoulder; in one hand a half-bored flute of dark bamboo with four finger-holes. Background: tall blurred bamboo scarred black by lightning, a faint green mist. Light: green-filtered light from the upper left. Expression: a closed, calm, reserved face with steady eyes and a still mouth that asks for nothing.

people.imagined: A foundling boy, humming a tune nobody taught him. He sits with a straw cape around his shoulders, trusting, in morning light.
people.subject: The moment: a small boy sits wrapped in a straw cape at morning, humming quietly with his eyes half closed, content and trusting. Face, most important: his two eyes are different colours, the left grey and the right brown, both clearly visible. A round, soft face of twelve; fair skin with rosy cheeks; fine light brows; a small button nose; a little open mouth humming. Hair: soft brown, tousled from sleep. Body: small, relaxed, sitting. Clothing: a clean white undyed hemp mourning shirt with a round neck and a white cord at the waist, and over it a straw rain cape of a river guide's kind, pale gold, too big for him and drooping at the shoulders. Hands: resting in his lap, one finger tapping softly. Background: pale dawn mist over old graves. Light: soft pink morning light from the upper left. Qi: a faint teal glimmer in the mist. The straw cape is a stiff overlapping sheaf of pale gold rice-straw tied at the neck with a twist of grass, and shows under it a very small pair of knees; his fingernails are clean and small, and the pink morning mist makes a halo around his tousled hair. Expression: half-closed eyes and a soft, trusting smile with lips humming, the small face relaxed.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the first elder at the age she went into the deepest grave to renew the ward: grave and brave, with a small tender smile for the sister she leaves outside.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded as on old silk, of a woman about to go down into a grave to renew a ward, looking out at the viewer with calm resolve and a tender, brief smile. Face, most important: a broad forehead with one vertical line between the brows, and her two palms pressed together in front of her chest as for a vow. A kind, firm, oval face of about forty-five; warm brown skin; dark steady eyes with softly crinkled corners; strong straight brows; a straight nose; a full mouth. Hair: black with one streak of white at the front, pinned in a high coil with a plain wooden pin. Body: tall, straight, calm. Clothing: an undyed hemp mourning robe of fine cloth with a crossed collar and an ash-grey sash; a black band at the cuffs; a small bronze bell charm on the sash. Background: the dim stone mouth of a grave, a faded teal mist. Light: soft pale glow from the upper left, as from an old lamp; the whole picture slightly faded, soft-edged and yellowed like old silk. Qi: a faint teal wash. Her pressed palms are long-fingered and unringed with a faint pale line along each thumb, the bronze bell charm at her sash is the size of a bean, and behind her the grave's mouth is a dim arch of stone with a few faded green marks on the lintel; the silk is yellowed and fine-cracked like old crackle glaze. Expression: a grave, resolute face with steady eyes and a small tender smile, faded like old silk.
